name: Campingplatz Elbsee
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Elbsee in Ruderatshofen is nestled directly on the shores of Lake Elbsee at the foothills of the Alps, near the Tyrolean border. The serene natural setting is perfect for cycling and hiking excursions. The park offers modern sanitary amenities, a kiosk, and dedicated beach access for swimming. Generous pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents provide comfort and privacy, making it a firm favourite for families and outdoor enthusiasts exploring the Außerfern region.
